func:
msg.topic = `
    SELECT
        t.id AS task_id,
        a.name AS thiet_bi,
        a.device_code,
        t.target_value AS lenh,
        t.source AS nguon,
        t.status AS trang_thai,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i:%s') AS tao_luc,
        COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(t.completed_at, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i:%s'), '') AS hoan_thanh_luc
    FROM task AS t
    INNER JOIN tasking_capability AS tc
        ON tc.id = t.tasking_capability_id
    INNER JOIN actuator AS a
        ON a.id = tc.actuator_id
    ORDER BY t.id DESC
    LIMIT 5
`;
msg.payload = [];
return msg;

info:
1) Cài @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard và node-red-node-mysql.
2) Mở config MySQL 'iot_mushroom' và nhập user/password.
3) Nếu MySQL chạy Docker, đổi Host từ 127.0.0.1 sang tên container hoặc host phù hợp.
4) Dashboard độc lập ở /mushroom-dashboard/history. Muốn ghép vào dashboard hiện tại, sửa ui-page 'Lịch sử' để dùng ui-base hiện có.
5) Flow tự nhận sensor mới nếu datastream.observed_property là temperature hoặc humidity; không cần thêm nhánh theo device_code.
6) Khi dữ liệu lớn, có thể thêm index: CREATE INDEX idx_task_created_status ON task(created_at, status); và CREATE INDEX idx_datastream_property ON datastream(observed_property, sensor_id);

Query temperature history
func:
msg.topic = `
    SELECT
        latest.time,
        latest.temperature
    FROM (
        SELECT
            o.id,
            UNIX_TIMESTAMP(o.observed_at) * 1000 AS time,
            o.value AS temperature,
            o.observed_at
        FROM observation AS o
        INNER JOIN datastream AS d
            ON d.id = o.datastream_id
        INNER JOIN sensor AS s
            ON s.id = d.sensor_id
        WHERE s.device_code = 'SENSOR_DHT11_01'
          AND d.observed_property = 'TEMPERATURE'
        ORDER BY
            o.observed_at DESC,
            o.id DESC
        LIMIT 30
    ) AS latest
    ORDER BY
        latest.observed_at ASC,
        latest.id ASC
`;

return msg;

name: format temperature
Query humidity history
func:
msg.topic = `
    SELECT
        latest.time,
        latest.humidity
    FROM (
        SELECT
            o.id,
            UNIX_TIMESTAMP(o.observed_at) * 1000 AS time,
            o.value AS humidity,
            o.observed_at
        FROM observation AS o
        WHERE o.datastream_id = 2
        ORDER BY
            o.observed_at DESC,
            o.id DESC
        LIMIT 30
    ) AS latest
    ORDER BY
        latest.observed_at ASC,
        latest.id ASC
`;

return msg;
